docs:
`preset-auth-hardened` installed the stable `auth:hardened` composition: Data, Authentication, and App access. Render `AuthHardenedConsoleKit` with a secret-free tenant descriptor.

Degraded states: each public endpoint and module fails closed independently, and PostgreSQL privileges and RLS remain authoritative.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/
